en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.367 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"When the soul reaches the throat, the person (believer), is shown their place in Paradise.
They say, 'Return me to the world so that I may inform my family about what I see.'
But it is said to them, 'There is no way for that.'"
